name: Illegal Loan App / Extortion Scam
ncrpCategory: Online Financial Fraud -> Illegal Loan Apps / Extortion
summary: Fraudulent instant loan apps that disburse small unauthorized amounts, charge excessive hidden fees within days, and use access to device contacts and photo galleries to blackmail and harass victims.
rules: Borrow only from RBI-registered Banks and NBFCs listed on the RBI Sachet portal.
Never grant permissions to your contacts list, photo gallery, or camera for instant credit applications.
initialActionChecklist: Immediately uninstall the fraudulent loan application and revoke all app permissions in device settings.
Do not transfer any extortion amounts or penalty payments demanded by recovery agents.
Preserve screenshots of all WhatsApp/SMS threats, abusive messages, and payment QR codes.
File an immediate complaint on cybercrime.gov.in under Illegal Loan Apps category and on RBI Sachet portal.
Notify family, friends, and contacts that your device was compromised by a scam app and to ignore fake abusive messages.
evidenceRequired: Screenshots of WhatsApp/SMS extortion messages, threats, and payment requests
App name, download URL, or APK file details
Bank statements showing any loan amount credited and subsequent extortion debits
Caller phone numbers and UPI IDs provided for extortion payments
source: RBI Sachet Advisory on Illegal Digital Lending Apps & MHA I4C
